industry.headline: California's AB 1709 heads to Governor Newsom, would strip 'addictive' feeds and autoplay for under-16 users
industry.summary: AB 1709, which cleared both chambers with near-unanimous votes, would require platforms to strip addictive feeds and autoplay for under-16 users while leaving basic account access intact; it now awaits Newsom's signature. Formalizes the exact behaviors NOMO targets as legally restricted, creating a policy tailwind for NOMO's compliant, pro-social positioning with US schools and parents.

industry.headline: Post-Meta Settlement Fallout: Google and TikTok Face Pressure to Match $17B Youth Safety Deal, New AG Suits Loom
industry.summary: Analysis of Meta's ~$17-18B settlement notes Google and TikTok face pressure to adopt similar teen-safety defaults or Meta's payout shrinks; state AGs are signaling further suits (including AI chatbots), and platforms are fighting a California statute over personalized minor feeds. Confirms sustained regulatory momentum strengthening the case for schools/brands to back independent alternatives like NOMO, relevant to CEO Leonardo's policy work in the UK/US/AU.

industry.headline: Meta's $17.1B teen-addiction settlement adds mandatory daily time limits and overnight curfews; appeals court strips Section 230 shield for app design claims
industry.summary: Meta agreed to pay up to $17.1B to settle 51-state-AG claims over addictive teen design, adding a two-hour daily time cap (shrinking to one hour if rivals match) and a midnight-6am block; separately, an appeals court ruled Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat can't use Section 230 to escape app-design lawsuits, opening 3,000+ harm suits. Validates NOMO's core mechanic but signals platforms may build native competing features, pushing NOMO to lean harder into social accountability and real-world prizes.

industry.headline: TikTok and ByteDance agree to $400M DOJ settlement over children's privacy violations
industry.summary: TikTok and ByteDance agreed to pay $400M to settle a DOJ lawsuit alleging COPPA violations for collecting under-13 data without parental consent, one of the largest COPPA recoveries ever. Raises the compliance bar for any youth-facing app handling minors' data — a talking point for NOMO's privacy-safe pitch to schools.
